feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: How personal data is being used to control what customers see and pay
entry.summary: NPR's Joel Rose speaks with Lindsay Owens, president of the economic think tank Groundwork Collaborative, about how companies using data to transform the products and prices customers see.

entry.title: Seafarer's union official says crews offered big money to transit Strait of Hormuz
entry.summary: As attacks continue to mount on shipping vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz, a seafarer's union official says some crews are being offered big rewards for making the crossing.

entry.title: Harrowing accounts of violence and sex abuse in women's prison told in new podcast
entry.summary: Madi Bolanos and Anna Sussman's new podcast We Are Jane Doe, by KQED and Snap Studios, investigates rampant sex abuse at the Central California Women's Facility in Chowchilla, Ca.

entry.title: Cineplexity: When your partner doesn't like the same movies you do
entry.summary: NPR producers and film buffs Marc Rivers and Kathryn Fink reflect on when a film they showed their significant others didn't go over so well.

entry.title: Demand rising for death doulas, who help with end-of-life care
entry.summary: Death doulas are non-medical professionals who help with end-of-life care. And their numbers are growing.

entry.title: Ukrainian MP calls U.S.-Russia diesel deal a 'betrayal'
entry.summary: NPR's Joel Rose speaks with Ukrainian Minister of Parliament, Oleksandr Merezhko, about the U.S.'s diesel deal with Russia will impact Ukraine.

entry.title: 'Genius grant' winner Immanuel Wilkins explains how he weaves Black history into his music
entry.summary: Saxophonist and composer Immanuel Wilkins talks about the impact that winning a 2026 MacArthur Fellowship will have on his art.

entry.title: For reporters covering AI, keeping up with story is both tough and exciting
entry.summary: How NPR's team covering AI covers their increasingly important and fast moving beat.

entry.title: Bayeux Tapestry's London tour spurs enthusiasts to Battle of Hastings reenactment
entry.summary: A reenactment of the Battle of Hastings, which took place almost a millennium ago, is drawing crowds of enthusiasts in the UK.

entry.title: Trump's economic strategy resemble similar policies in East Asia
entry.summary: Much of the Trump administration's economic policy has been inspired by successful industrial policies successful in East Asia, including those of competitor, China. Will those policies work in the U.S.?
